label: Octopus Energy
description: API credentials and meter identity. Provides energy_price and energy_usage for the Energy module.

settings.name: api_key
settings.label: API key
settings.help: From Octopus account → Personal details / API access. Server-side only. Do not commit.

settings.name: account_number
settings.label: Account number
settings.help: Optional. e.g. A-XXXXXXXX — helps resolve Home Mini deviceId

settings.name: meter_serial
settings.label: Meter serial
settings.help: Meter serial number from Octopus / meter

settings.name: device_id
settings.label: Mini device id
settings.help: Optional override. Auto-resolved from account/MPAN when empty

settings.name: gap_fill_min_sec
settings.label: Gap-fill min seconds
settings.help: Min seconds between Mini GraphQL backfill windows (pink usage holes toward REST). Default 60. Was 300 when KT-CT-1199 was blamed on telemetry; login rate limits are separate. Clamped 30–3600.
